data.name: Kanizah
data.long_meaning: A woman with a basket or container. Derived from the Arabic word 'kinza', which means 'container' or 'enclosure'.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes protection, nurturing, and providing for one's family.

in_arabic.name: كنيزة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الْكَنِيزَةُ هِيَ اسْمٌ عَرَبِيٌّ يَدُلُ عَلَى الْعَبْدَةِ أَوِ الْخَادِمَةِ، وَهُوَ مَأْخُوذٌ مِنْ كَنَزَ يَكْنِزُ كَنزًا وَكَنِيزَةً، وَمَعْنَاهُ الْحِفْظُ وَالْخِفْظَةُ. وَقَدْ ذُكِرَتْ كَنِيزَةٌ فِي الْقُرْآنِ الْكَرِيمِ كَعَبْدَةٍ مُؤْمِنَةٍ.

in_urdu.name: کنیزہ
in_urdu.meaning: کنیزہ کا مطلب ہے خادمہ یا عبدہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: کنیزہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خادمہ یا عبدہ۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا معنی ہے حفاظت کرنا یا محفوظ رکھنا۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم روایات میں، کنیزہ ایک ایسے نام کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے جو عبادت اور خدمت کی عظمت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: कनिज़ाह
in_hindi.meaning: कनिज़ाह का अर्थ है दासी या सेविका
in_hindi.long_meaning: कनिज़ाह एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है दासी या सेविका। यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है और इसका अर्थ है रक्षा करना या सुरक्षित रखना। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, कनिज़ाह एक ऐसे नाम के रूप में देखा जाता है जो पूजा और सेवा की महत्ता को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: کانيزه
in_pashto.meaning: کانيزه د خادمه يا عبدې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: کانيزه يو عربي نوم دی چې د خادمه يا عبدې معنی لري. دا نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخیستل شوی دی او د ساتنې يا خوندي کولو معنی لري. د افغان او پښتنو مسلمو دودونو کې، کانيزه داسې يو نوم دی چې د عبادت او خدمت عظمت ښيي.

in_english.name: Kanizah
in_english.meaning: Kanizah means servant, slave, or handmaiden
in_english.long_meaning: Kanizah is an Arabic name derived from the root 'k-n-z', meaning to protect or preserve. In Islamic tradition, Kanizah refers to a servant, slave, or handmaiden. The name has historical significance, reflecting the cultural and spiritual values of servitude and devotion. Kanizah symbolizes humility, obedience, and piety.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Kanizah" is of Arabic origin, and carries with it a rich cultural heritage in the Islamic tradition. In many parts of the Middle East and North Africa, this name is quite common. It evokes images of a woman of strength and resilience, carrying the hopes, dreams, and burdens of her family and community. In some cultures, the name is also associated with the blessings of Allah, as a reminder of the precious and nourishing role women play in the family unit, akin to the role of a container that holds and safeguards precious contents.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Kanizah" carries a deep spiritual meaning, as it is derived from the Arabic word 'kinza', which signifies a container or enclosure. In the Islamic tradition, the human spirit is often referred to as the 'container' of the soul, and the soul is considered to be a 'container' of the Beloved, which is none other than Allah. Thus, the name "Kanizah" serves as a reminder of the sacred trust that every person has in carrying and safeguarding the divine presence within themselves. It also serves as an invitation to be a vessel of blessings and light for all those around us.
